_comment: gpt-5.6-luna through the provider-openai plugin, which is what a deployment naming this model actually runs. The plugin already knows the two things the raw endpoint refuses — `max_tokens` (it wants `max_completion_tokens`) and function tools alongside reasoning (it wants reasoning_effort 'none') — and recovers from the 400 rather than needing either spelled out here. Concurrency is pinned low because the org TPM cap binds long before the model does. `seed` is off because the plugin talks the Responses API, which has no such parameter — so repeats on this target vary freely rather than being reproducible. That is a property of the provider, not of the benchmark.
